items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: John played On "Body and Soul," tenor. I never heard anything any better.

ctx.x: tenor player. Did he record on tenor with you?

No, he recorded but -- at the Five Spot one time when Sonny Rollins had a band there. John played On "Body and Soul," tenor. I never heard anything any better. I never knew anyone " " could play Body and Soul any better.
How about Paul Blay? I always liked him playing with you.
